method: Fresh three-process cluster and temporary data directories per trial. 20 SET and 20 GET warmup operations excluded. Timed GETs validate returned bytes. Normal File.Sync path. Elected leader ordered first in client addresses after warmup. Eight workers, 1024-byte values. Profiling trial excluded from summary.
